title: Might work for really large ears of corn.
text: Might work for really large ears of corn.. This works, sort of, on the wide end of the ear, but not on the narrow end. Also, it comes pretty far onto the ear. I'm going to try them again and will update this review if anything changes.

product_metadata.title: HOME-X Corn on The Cob Holders - Large Handle Pin Grips - Great for Home Cooking, BBQ, Picnics, Camping and Parties-1 Pair
features: UNIQUE DESIGN- These corn cob holders are designed to easily grasp and hold corn-on-the-cob. Enjoy the hot and freshly grilled or boiled corn snack with these cob skewers.
SAFER - Safer to use than sharply pointed corn-on-the-cob holders. Great for use by children and adults alike.
EASY TO USE - Simply press open and place on the end of the cob, then release in place. Jaw opens from 1.5" to 2.25" wide. The large plastic handle provides a secure and comfortable grip.
DETAILS - Each cob holder measures 3.5"H x 3"W. Jaw opens from 1.5" to 2.25" wide. Stay clean and mess-free while eating a mouth-watering corn on the cob.
PARTY AND HOME USE - It is always a good idea to have this set at home. You can also use them as a tabletop serveware at home, barbecue parties, family picnics, camping with friends and more.
